steps.shift: Most melodies go beyond five notes, so the hand moves while it plays: a position shift. The fingering shows where. Here, after the long {g} played with finger 5, the hand moves up so finger 2 lands on {a}. Move during the long note, and look ahead to where the hand is going.
steps.shiftRight: Climb, move the hand during the half note, and carry on in the new position.
steps.shiftRightInTime: Now in time: the move has to fit inside the half note.
steps.shiftLeft: The left hand moves the same way. Here it walks down from {g} to {c}, then moves down so finger 2 lands on {b}, and carries on in a new position.
steps.walkDown: Down, move during the half note, and on.
